---
title: "Catalog members"
description: "One generated entry per blueprint, resource and trait in the abstraction family."

The abstraction catalog, `opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm@v4`, defines the blueprints, resources and traits that a module builds its components from. Each member has a generated page, blueprints first, and every page has the same parts in the same order: the summary, the member at a glance, its spec, notes from its doc comment, the transformers that serve it, and what enforces its rules.
